newsitem.title: UK: Sugar freight business subdued, business routine.
newsitem.headline: Sugar freight business subdued, business routine.

text.p: London's sugar freight market saw a routine run of business on Thursday, but activity was still relatively subdued, shipbrokers said.

Mauritius Sugar Syndicate entered the market with two new bulk sugar orders, both from Port Louis. It quoted for 16,000 tonnes min/max to Leixoes for mid-August and 14,000 tonnes to London for similar dates.
Louis Dreyfus was open for a prompt 15/20,000 tonnes of bulk sugar from the Philippines to US Gulf/Atlantic.
Sugar Exporters quoted for 13,000 tonnes in bags from Itajai or Imbituba to Lagos for mid-August.
Of the day's firmer business, CSR fixed 40,000 tonnes of bulk sugar from Queensland to Adabiya for mid-August and 20,000 tonnes to Savannah/Gramercy for August 13/23.
Genoc fixed 20,000 tonnes from Thailand to Vladivostok or Novorossisk for August 8/15.
